step.action: Put loose food and MOOP from 🍳 Cooking_Surfaces in 📦 Trash_Bins.
Spray food, grease, visible dirt, and sticky residue with 🍳 Multisurface_Cleaner.
Wipe the sprayed areas with 🍳 Disposable_Towels until no food, grease, visible dirt, or sticky residue remains.
Leave the sanitized areas wet for the contact time printed on 🍳 Food_Surface_Sanitizer.

passWhen.criterion: No food, grease, visible dirt, sticky residue, or MOOP remains.
Food-contact areas were sanitized and are dry.

reasoning.entry: Clean visible soil before sanitizing because sanitizer does not replace cleaning.
Air-dry sanitized food-contact areas so a used towel does not contaminate them again.
